consumer: The engine's fetch-mission objective/eligibility check that asks 'are the required parts now accounted for?' to light the 'objective met' indicator.
scope: The objective's full accounting reach (the engine's own fetch/find-item predicate over carried inventory plus reachable items), not ground tiles within an export-window radius.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities(items) — scans get_map().i_at(p) for each in-window tile and serializes raw ground-item stacks, i.e. raw simulation state, never the mission objective predicate.
divergence: The required parts sit in the player's backpack/inventory (carried, not on any ground tile): the engine's objective predicate reads 'met' and the indicator should light, but the i_at ground scan reports none of them, so the proposal leaves the indicator dark.
